user.title: Room Advisor
user.description:
Room Advisor tells you what is worth doing in each room, and why, as entities your automations can use.

These are the inputs every room shares, so you only set them once. All optional — a missing one only switches off the advice that needs it. You can change them later from this hub's settings.

Add your rooms next.

data_description.outdoor_temperature: A thermometer or a weather entity. Used to decide whether opening a window would help.
data_description.outdoor_humidity: A hygrometer or a weather entity. Stops a window being suggested when the outside air is muggy.
data_description.outdoor_air_quality: An AQI or particulate sensor. Stops a window being suggested when the outside air is poor.
data_description.rain_risk: Something that turns on when rain worth closing a window for is expected. Forecasts are not read.
data_description.away: An alarm panel, or the people whose absence means the house is empty. Away when every one of them is.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Already configured. There is one Room Advisor hub per house; add each room to the existing hub.

user.title: Add a room
user.description: Pick the area this room covers and Room Advisor will suggest its entities. If the room does not match a single area, leave this empty and give the room a name instead.

data_description.area_id: Used to suggest this room's entities and to file its device.
data_description.name: Leave empty to name the room after its area.

reconfigure.title: Configure room
reconfigure.description:
Point this room at a different area, then choose the entities it reads on the next step. Its entity IDs do not change.

To rename the room, use Rename in its menu.

data_description.area_id: Where this room's device is filed. Entities are suggested from the area only when a room is first added.

inputs.title: Room entities
inputs.description: Choose what this room reads. Everything is optional: a missing entity only switches off the advice that needs it, so start with what you have.

data_description.indoor_temperature: Used by window and fan advice.
data_description.indoor_co2: Used to advise airing the room out.
data_description.occupancy: Used by fan and lighting advice.
data_description.window_contacts: Every window this room has. Advice to open a window stops once one is open.
data_description.hvac: Used to avoid advising an open window while heating or cooling is running.

error.unknown_area: That area no longer exists. Pick another one, or leave it empty.
error.name_required: Give the room a name, or pick an area to name it after.
error.name_taken: There is already a room with this name.
